R824.note: Rejects negative offset before unsigned conversion and reorders the bounds check to avoid overflow/underflow, matching the stated contract exactly.

R825.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption pattern from /api/** to /api/webhooks/** to match the documented intent already present in comments; no other behavior change.

R826.note: Adds an allowlist for the ORDER BY column (required since identifiers can't be parameterized) while AccountId/Query stay bound parameters; default created_at sort is in the allowlist.

R827.note: Binds tokens via req.session.userId, which closes the reported cross-session reuse; a valid but less canonical identifier than the session ID itself.

R828.note: Binds tokens via req.sessionID, the canonical per-session identifier the csrf-csrf library's getSessionIdentifier option is documented for.

R829.note: Replaces Sprintf string building with a parameterized ? placeholder query passed to Exec, preserving all existing error handling and response formatting.

R830.note: Moves free() entirely into the caller and removes it from the callee's error path, restoring single ownership with no double-free or leak on either return path.

R831.note: Replaces DES/CBC/zero-IV with AES-GCM and a random nonce; the ciphertext format change (nonce prefix, auth tag) is an unavoidable, disclosed consequence of fixing the weak-algorithm finding, and no decrypting consumer exists in this single-file case.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) performs overflow-checked multiplication and returns NULL on overflow, matching the contract's return-NULL-without-leak requirement for oversized counts.

R833.note: Switches exec(String) to exec(String[]) removing the concatenated command string; functionally equivalent for legitimate single-token data values.

R834.note: Corrects the loop bound from i<=n to i<n, an exact minimal fix matching the stated contract.

R835.note: Adds reference counting on Connection so the callback's stale pointer stays valid until process_work_queue finishes with it; traced execution shows no double-free or leak.

R836.note: Parameterizes the query with a ? placeholder and array argument via mysql2, the standard fix; handler logic unchanged.

R837.note: Matches the stated contract exactly: generic 500 body, logger.error still called, success and 404 paths untouched.

R838.note: Regex allowlist blocks traversal sequences and null bytes and rejects before require() executes, matching the stated contract.

R839.note: Verified against real spring-security-web and spring-security-config 6.5.8 jars: no SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler class exists in org.springframework.security.web.csrf (it's a doc-sample class developers must define themselves) and CsrfConfigurer has no .requestHandler(...) method (only csrfTokenRequestHandler(CsrfTokenRequestHandler)); the fix will not compile and leaves the CSRF mismatch unresolved.
